signature_features: Two TF34-GE-100 turbofans in separate nacelles high on the aft fuselage between wing and tail
Twin vertical fins on the ends of a straight tailplane, masking engine exhaust
Straight, thick low wing with 11 pylons (8 underwing, 3 under fuselage) and drooping wingtips
GAU-8/A 30 mm cannon muzzle under the nose, nose gear offset to the right; main gear retracting forward into wing pods, partly exposed
Bubble canopy set high on a blunt nose; 1989 USAFE aircraft in two-tone dark green/gray European I scheme
